title: Orthogonalized task-vector Mirror superposition
hypothesis: Bind related task deltas using a compact orthogonal Mirror address, sum the bound vectors into one physical state, and unbind by task address to retain low-interference logical edits with lower bytes than independent deltas and ordinary PSP; independent tasks require private or richer state.
physical_object: One shared base vector and one superposed task-delta vector
mirror_coordinate: One float32 task angle m_t for a deterministic block-Givens orthogonal Q(m_t)
logical_multiplicity: Eight held-out task functions from one superposed delta state

task.quality: normalized held-out function MSE; also signed pair-sum and pair-difference MSE

controls: Rademacher Parameter Superposition with charged packed sign contexts
direct shared-orbit generator storing one seed vector and task angles
Mirror inverse-bind, superpose, and task-address unbind

allowed_selection: PSP context seed from fixed candidate list
development.selection_metric: mean normalized held-out task and signed-composition MSE, then actual serialized bytes and throughput

storage.serializer: deterministic typed tensor records charging IDs, names, shapes, dtype, raw bytes, metadata and headers
paid_objects: PSP packed sign contexts and superposed state

success_gate: Every fresh aligned world: Mirror task and signed-composition normalized MSE <=1.10x direct shared-orbit generator; payload <=0.5x independent full; throughput >=0.5x direct generator. Mirror-specific value additionally requires >=10% better actual quality/byte/compute frontier than byte-matched PSP and direct shared-orbit generator.
failure_gate: Mirror is function/quality matched or dominated by the direct shared-orbit generator at equal/lower payload, misses aligned quality/storage/runtime gate, or cannot recover independent tasks without measured private state.
boundaries: known task identities and supplied angles; no learned router
fixed-function screen, not learning efficiency or capacity

amendments.change: Freeze PSP context seed 296103 and SVD rank 8 from development-only selection.
amendments.reason: Development chose the Rademacher context seed by mean task MSE over both conditions and worlds, and the SVD rank by aligned task MSE; fresh seeds remain sealed.
